title: Make Default moves the tag and changes no existing customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 14 days after the invoice date.
  • Make sure customer A holds COD, with a credit limit of $0.00.
  • Write down the COD row's Customers count before you start.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Click "Make Default".
  4. Open customer A's customer page in a new tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The confirmation closes, the "Default" tag moves from COD to term A, and a green toast shows "term A is now the default" with the line "New customers start on term A." The COD row's Customers count is unchanged.

Step 4:

  • Customer A's "Credit term" still reads COD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R6: “On "Make Default", the term becomes the default, the "Default" tag moves to its row, and a success toast shows "{name} is now the default" with the line "New customers start on {name}." No customer, vendor or invoice changes.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Make Default confirmed | "{name} is now the default" / "New customers start on {name}." | Success toast with a Close action”
  • Terminology: “Make Default vs Move Customers → Make Default changes only which term new customers start on. Move Customers changes the term of existing customers the user picks. Neither does the other's job.”
  • Terminology: “Default (default credit term) → The term a new customer starts on. It never changes an existing customer.”
  • Key Decisions: “A changed default applies to new customers only; moving existing customers is a separate, explicit action (Move Customers).”
  • Key Decisions: “The default can be any active term except Credit Hold.”
  • Goals: “A user with 'Settings → Finance' can set the default term for new customers to any active term except Credit Hold, and every customer created afterwards in ShopView, by contacts import or by the Public API without a term starts on it.”
